g.title: aPAP_QSP
g.text: Autoimmune Pulmonary Alveolar Proteinosis (aPAP) — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
surfactant mass balance · GM-CSF autoantibody buffer · alveolar macrophage catabolic capacity · gas-exchange physics · 25 modules

g.title: cluster_gen
g.text: 1. Susceptibility, exposure and PAP disease class

g.title: cluster_gmprod
g.text: 4. Endogenous GM-CSF in the alveolus (pg/mL, not ng/mL)

g.title: cluster_ab
g.text: 2. GM-CSF autoantibody generation (the lesion that never leaves)

g.title: cluster_buffer
g.text: 5. Stoichiometric buffer — 10^4-fold molar excess of antibody sites over ligand

g.title: cluster_abdist
g.text: 3. Antibody distribution: serum, extravascular pool, and epithelial lining fluid

g.title: cluster_sig
g.text: 6. GM-CSF receptor and proximal signalling (high-affinity dodecamer)

g.title: cluster_tx
g.text: 7. Terminal-differentiation program (the part the antibody actually destroys)

g.title: cluster_am
g.text: 8. Alveolar macrophage population: number is preserved, function is not

g.title: cluster_synth
g.text: 9. Surfactant synthesis and lamellar-body secretion (unchanged in aPAP)

g.title: cluster_balance
g.text: 10. ALVEOLAR SURFACTANT MASS BALANCE — recycling is a loop, not a sink

g.title: cluster_sat
g.text: 11. Why the pool reaches 50x normal: the surviving sinks saturate and are then physically excluded

g.title: cluster_chol
g.text: 12. Cholesterol arm: what the macrophage cannot get rid of

g.title: cluster_gas
g.text: 14. Gas-exchange physics: A-aDO2 and DLCO are COMPUTED from shunt, diffusion and O2 transport

g.title: cluster_inf
g.text: 16. Host-defence failure and opportunistic infection (the risk WLL does not remove)

g.title: cluster_fib
g.text: 17. Irreversible remodelling: the ceiling on recovery

g.title: cluster_bio
g.text: 18. Circulating biomarkers (alveolar-to-blood leak, proportional to the pool)

g.title: cluster_clin
g.text: 19. Clinical endpoints and disease severity score

g.title: cluster_inh
g.text: 20. Inhaled recombinant GM-CSF: molgramostim, sargramostim (the buffer-overwhelming route)

g.title: cluster_sc
g.text: 21. Systemic GM-CSF (subcutaneous): the same drug in the wrong compartment

g.title: cluster_wll
g.text: 22. Whole lung lavage: removes the pool, not the cause — and washes out the antibody

g.title: cluster_abtx
g.text: 23. Antibody-directed therapy: attacking the buffer instead of overwhelming it

g.title: cluster_ae
g.text: 25. Adverse effects: the same occupancy curve, read on non-target cells

g.title: Molar_ratio
g.text: MOLAR RATIO R = ligand sites / antibody sites

g.title: Flux_mac
g.text: ~65% of net sink — the arm that fails

g.title: Flux_rec
g.text: large flux, ZERO net effect at steady state

g.title: Imbalance
g.text: => years to fill, integral not rate

g.title: Km_II
g.text: Km near the NORMAL pool size

g.title: Posfeed
g.text: more filling -> less clearance -> more filling

g.title: Twostate
g.text: this feedback is SUB-CRITICAL. There is ONE
equilibrium burden per catabolic floor, reached
from either direction - no bistability, no
hysteresis. The clinical spread is a steep
single-valued dependence on that floor, not

g.title: Nonlin
g.text: long silent phase, then rapid decline

g.title: Bio_note
g.text: GMAb titre does not track SEVERITY

g.title: Ratio_win
g.text: 8.3 nmol ligand vs ~0.16 nmol neutralising sites

g.title: Infl_lung
g.text: if signalling is driven far above normal

g.title: Cont_int
g.text: same dose per day, different coverage

g.title: Ab_neutral_sys
g.text: Neutralisation by the LARGE serum antibody pool

g.title: WLL
g.text: 10-40 L saline per lung, GA + DLT

g.title: WLL_dur
g.text: Median benefit years, >70% recurrence-free at 7 y

g.title: FcRn_eff
g.text: helps only if baseline titre is near threshold
